## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, what "fuzzy"
means, and how labels are normalised. `folded` (new on 25 Sep) is a placement whose line begins
with the headword once the spellings of `tools/abhidhana_fold.py` are folded: either a headword
the other passes left unplaced, or a fuzzy placement so confirmed. Every row is `status: "ocr"`.
Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 6 specifics

- **961 pages carry index entries**, 960 in the index itself plus p. 852 (below). 11,429 index
  headwords, 11,232 distinct. Located 92.0%, label + body 86.3%: a little below vols. 3 and 5.
  The unlocated are spread thin (the worst page, p. 833, has 12 of 20); 710 of the 915 are present
  somewhere in the page text, but not at the head of an entry.
- **The index files 14 headwords a page early**: ဂါဟေတဗ္ဗဂါမ … ဂါဟေဿာမိ (ids 58264–58277) are indexed
  at p. 851 and printed on p. 852, which the index skips. Found as an unindexed page inside the body
  whose entries begin with a neighbour's unlocated headwords; checked on the image (below). They are
  now read on p. 852 (`ID_PAGE_FIX`), and all 14 are placed. The same test over vols. 3, 4/3 and 5
  finds only the known case in 4/3 (p. 615 → p. 613).
- **Against the typed witness** (`docs/witness-join.md`): it has 11,214 of the 11,232 distinct
  headwords (99.8%). Labels agree on 99.4% of the 9,865 rows where both have one; analyses are
  ≥ 0.8 similar in 90.6%, < 0.4 in 0.4%.
- **A label the map did not have**: (ကာ၊ကြိ၊ဝိ), the causative absolutive (ဂါဟေတွာ, p. 852). It had
  been cut to (ကာ၊ကြိ). Now mapped (`docs/labels.md` §7), in every volume.
- **Readings left unnormalised** include (ထိန) 8, (ထီ၊၇) 4, (ထိ၊ ၇) 3, (ထိ၊န) 3: probably (ထီ၊န) and
  (ထီ၊ပု), not yet image-checked (`docs/labels.md` §7).

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `06.pdf` at 75 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 500 | an ordinary page | 22 | 19 | 0 | 3 | 19 right |
| 110 | the worst page with 10 or more headwords (4 of 10 read verbatim) | 10 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 10 right |
| 852 | the page the index skips | 14 | 14 | 0 | 0 | 13 right, 1 cut short |

- **P. 500** is a run of causative forms of ခမတိ, all (ကာ၊ကြိ), with two homonyms ခမာပေသိ¹ ², both
  placed right. Unlocated: ခမာပေန္တ, ခမာပေသိံ (printed with its anusvāra set apart, ခမာပေသိ ံ) and
  ခမိတ, the last entry on the page.
- **P. 110** prints ကုက္ကုဋသမ္ပာတ… where the index writes သမ္ပါတ (ါ/ာ after a stacked consonant), and
  the OCR reads ဋ as ဌ or ဠ in three headwords. Seven of the ten are placed by folding. Six were
  compared on the image entry by entry; the other four by their opening words, which match the
  printed headwords.
- **P. 852**: the fourteen headwords are all printed here, each placed at its entry. The label of
  ဂါဟေတွာ is printed (ကာ၊ကြိ၊ဝိ) and was read so, but normalised to (ကာ၊ကြိ); fixed.

No article on the three pages is placed at a wrong entry.
